Read by bin/main-red-pr-pair.sh as ${MAIN_RED_PAIR_FREEZE:-1}. BH-1451: when a PR pair fires AND bin/main-red-detector.sh's own verdict (the main_red_verdicts row since BH-4156, or state/main-red/<slug>.verdict with no row store) says decision=none, this lane raises flags/main-red-<slug> (reason=pr-pair-suspected, owner=main-red-pr-pair) and every merge lane holds. 0 = the lane alerts exactly as it did before BH-1451 and writes no flag; a freeze it already raised is still cleared, so the switch cannot strand one.

Read by bin/main-red-pr-pair.sh as ${MAIN_RED_SKIP_RE:-(e2e|nightly|smoke|publish|deploy)}, and by bin/main-red-detector.sh (not a lane) as a contract reader of this same row: settings row, then env, then the default; a value that does not compile falls back to the default there with one warn (BH-3769). Matched case-insensitively against a workflow's name OR its path in both readers. Python decides in the detector and jq (onig) in both, so keep to syntax both dialects read alike.
